description:
Create element nodes from the factory (never hand-write nodes). Pick the operation with `action` and pass that action's arguments (help:true returns its full documentation and schema).
- new_element: Build a single structurally-valid element node from the real builder factory.
- new_section: Build a complete section node with children laid out in the builder's vertical grid.
- new_row: Build a multi-column ROW container: children laid out SIDE BY SIDE (not stacked).
- new_page_skeleton: Return an empty but valid page source: { sections: [] }. Add sections built with new_section, then save with build_page.

children.description: Child element specs, stacked vertically in the section [new_section, new_row]

collapse.description: Columns to show per breakpoint, e.g. [new_row]

container_opts.description: Optional factory opts for the row container node itself (e.g. [new_row]

help.description: Return the action's full documentation and argument schema instead of running it

hug.description: Content-sized columns (max-content): a menu, pills, a button group — not cards [new_row]

opts.description: Factory opts: { text, src, width, height, style, config, specials, events, bindings, responsive, … [new_element]

section_opts.description: Optional factory opts for the section node itself [new_section]

name: compose
